title: Deliver reproducible selected-source local editions

verificationRecords.notes: Nine baseline tests pass; current production sizes recorded in review.
Fourteen checks pass after correcting the test padding to count UTF-8 bytes; actual calculus limit and Bayes bounded reader fixed.
Four tests pass; existing source, explanation and branded edition identities suffice. Full typecheck also passes including negative identity assignment.
Four checks and full typecheck pass; complete domain reproduction rejects altered payloads even with recomputed hashes.
Five tests pass; full types pass. Real CLI check reproduces selected stationary edition.
Static edition reads all five passages and native math with JavaScript disabled and no external resources.
Eighteen checks and full types pass; all four writer consumers preserve valid editions while undeclared files, directories and links are rejected.
Twenty-one tests and full types pass, including injected write/rename failures, corrupted race winner and six independent processes converging.
All three browsers pass no-script local reading and font load. Replaced unsupported promise callback in Firefox JavaScript-disabled test with synchronous font-state polling; product unchanged.
Ten checks and full types pass; every referenced font and shared style preserved.
Two independent production builds yield identical complete local closure; renderer editor remains lazy; full types pass.
Fifteen tests and full types pass; edition closure excludes KaTeX renderer, view and preview staging.
Seven canonical editor preservation checks pass after sharing one playback surface.
Five checks pass; static and interactive modes retain source identity, differ in byte identity, and detect reader alteration; full types pass.
Three cases pass: no-script static and both fresh interactive selected sources, no external requests or author controls.
Five browser cases pass: fresh-context and reload exact samples, reverse, signed/zero increments and explicit different-edition rejection. Full types pass.
All seven editor preservation checks pass; shared mounting options are explicit.
Ten tests pass including round-trip grid, duplicate, malformed, nonfinite and out-of-range links; full types pass.
Six browser cases pass including invalid link preservation and correction clearing the diagnostic.

expectedLearning: Measure exact selected-source publication and restoration through existing domain and edition owners.
allowedWork: The approved 22 slices in the reproducible-authoring proposal, within its ten-hour ceiling and preservation boundaries
disallowedWork: New mathematics, visual redesign, universal framework, deployment, unrelated cleanup or paid services
